features.title: Features
features.intro: Decide what sellers and buyers can use at your bazaar. You can change this until the end of the bazaar.
features.discountsText: Sellers can lower their prices during the bazaar, for example towards the end of the day.
features.discountFromHint: Leave empty if discounts are allowed from the start.
features.offersText: During the bazaar, logged-in buyers suggest a price for accepted items. If the seller accepts, that price applies at the cash desk. Sellers decide per item whether they accept offers.
features.minimumText: Sellers set a minimum price per item that buyers do not see. At the cash desk the price may be negotiated down to it.
features.questionsText: Buyers ask public questions about an item and the seller answers. Everyone sees the answers, which avoids duplicate questions.
features.photosOptionalText: Sellers do not have to photograph every item – useful for many small items as at a children's bazaar. Items without photo show a placeholder.
features.publicCatalogText: Visitors see the items online with price and photos once they are handed in; sold ones disappear. Switched off there is no online list – on site the QR label still shows the price. Price offers and questions need the online list.
features.maxItemsHint: Limits how many items a seller can register – so that intake and space are sufficient.
features.intakeFeeHint: Fixed fee for every accepted item, even if it does not sell – for example 3 € per bike. It is deducted from the payout at settlement, in addition to the commission. Once the first seller has registered, you can only lower it.
features.labelsHint: Every label shows QR code, title and – if given – the size.
features.labelMarkUniversal: Universal label: the seller's lasting sorting mark
features.labelMarkUniversalHint: Helpers first sort by the large digit into ten piles, then by letters and number into the basket. The mark stays with the seller, so the labels also fit other bazaars with universal labels.
features.labelMarkNoneHint: Labels can be reused. To sort items back, the team has to scan every one.
features.priceOnLabel: Print the price on the label
features.priceOnLabelText: Buyers see the price at once, without scanning. With discounts the label shows the starting price, the cash desk takes the discount off.
features.priceOnLabelDiscounts: Discounts are on: the label shows the starting price, the cash desk takes the discount off. Best announce it with a sign.
features.payOnSite: Payment still happens on site at the cash desk.
features.maxItemsLocked: Sellers registered with this limit: you can only raise it.
features.maxItemsLater: Once the first seller has registered, you can only raise it.
features.questionsDuringEventText: Items are visible beforehand, but questions can only be asked once the bazaar starts. Existing answers stay visible.
features.requiredFieldsText: Every item needs these details before it can be registered for the bazaar, e.g. the frame number as proof for the police. They only apply to categories that have the field. If something is missing, BazarPro asks the seller when registering the item.
features.privateSellersText: When registering, sellers confirm that they sell as private persons, not commercially.
features.fixedDataText: At the intake on site you check name and address against the ID card; if they differ, the seller corrects them in their profile first. From the first accepted item on they are fixed, and so are title, category, price and required details of every accepted item. This gives a reliable record of who offered what, e.g. for the police. Sellers need a complete profile for this.
features.directSale: Direct sale: buyers pay the seller
features.directSaleText: Buyer and seller agree at the item, the buyer pays the seller directly. Then the cash desk scans the label, books the sale at the agreed price and takes only the commission from the seller. Nothing is paid out after the bazaar, and the record still shows every sale.
features.discountFromNeedsDates: Choose the start and end of the bazaar first.
features.registrationOpenText: Sellers register themselves on the bazaar page. Switched off, only the people you invite get in.
features.registrationWindowHint: Leave empty if registration opens right away and stays open until the bazaar ends. Invitations work outside this time too.
features.registrationClosedHint: Registration is closed. New sellers only get in with an invitation.
features.registrationWindow: Registration must end after it begins.
features.maxItemsTotalHint: Limits the items of all sellers together, e.g. to what fits into the hall. Sellers see how many places are left. If you lower the limit, registered items stay.
features.maxFeesHint: A seller pays at most this much commission and intake fee in total, e.g. 20 € for expensive bikes. Whatever is above it goes back to them with the settlement. At a direct sale the cash desk then takes no more commission.
features.maxFeesLater: Once the first seller has registered, you can only lower it.
features.feeExampleHint: The conditions work out an example that fits the kind of bazaar, e.g. one bike for 150 € instead of six items for 5 € each.

logistics.title: Drop-off & pickup
logistics.intro: Sellers with registered items get an email with all information at 6 pm the evening before. Everyone not yet settled gets a pickup reminder: right after the bazaar or, if pickup starts later, 2 hours before it.
logistics.introDirect: At a direct sale sellers stand at their items themselves: the times are for setup and teardown. Sellers with registered items get an email with all information at 6 pm the evening before. Everyone not yet settled gets a teardown reminder: right after the bazaar or, if teardown starts later, 2 hours before it.

feeGroups.title: Fee groups (optional)
feeGroups.hint: Own fees for a group of sellers, e.g. club members 5 % instead of 10 % or helpers without commission. Sellers see all groups in the conditions. Up to 4 groups, each seller is in one at most. Who belongs to two groups (e.g. helper and member) gets the one with the lower commission, at equal commission the one with the lower intake fee. So a high intake fee does not make a group count as dearer than one with more commission.
feeGroups.empty: All sellers pay the same fees. With a group, e.g. club members or helpers pay less.
feeGroups.label: Name of the group

assignment.selfDeclaredHint: Sellers choose the group themselves when registering. At the drop-off the team checks the proof and confirms or removes the group. Until then no item can be accepted. Until then the normal fees and item limit apply.
assignment.helpersHint: Applies automatically to everyone with a helper role, as long as they have it. You can also assign helpers without rights. Only one group can apply to helpers.
assignment.manualHint: Sellers cannot choose the group themselves. You assign it in the seller list or at the seller, e.g. cake donors or the board.

feeGroups.itemsHint: Empty: the bazaar's limit applies. The limit for the whole market applies to everyone.

region.title: Only sellers from the region
region.intro: Only people whose postal code is in the chosen areas can register on their own, for example families from your town. Everyone else only with an invitation, even if the bazaar has an access code. Choose the centre, drag the radius and tap single areas on the map to add or remove them.
